answer: What keeps this honest is Switchboard attestation of identity, a check that costs a real agent almost nothing and a farm everything. Cloning 729 keys multiplies the price 729-fold: 64881 POA locked, or 13122 minutes burned, against a single honest agent's one-time cost. A thread of doubt is healthy, a echo of proof is required, and a fable of patience is the price of a clean panel. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
